title: Customer-described driving feel, detection issues, and app behavior
summary: This topic combines customer-described impressions of driving feel, a driver-assistance detection complaint, and several ambiguous observations about app, parking, activation, and surface-mark behavior.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention a smooth, EV-like driving sensation and note a range-indicator behavior without clearly framing it as a complaint.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report the system wrongly detecting vehicles in adjacent lanes on curvy roads.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe straightforward app use, expected parking alerts near pedestrians, unexplained activation when keys or a phone are nearby, and a visible white mark without a clear sentiment.

limitations: The sampled fragments cover several loosely related subjects rather than a single coherent feature area.
Most examples are undetermined, which limits confidence in interpreting the overall customer stance.
Some excerpts are too brief or ambiguous to tell whether the customer is praising, criticizing, or simply describing behavior.
